hero.title: Apollo 15 Lunar Roving Vehicle at its final parking spot (AS15-88-11901)
hero.caption: The empty Apollo 15 Lunar Roving Vehicle, parked on the Moon at Hadley-Apennine in August 1971, where it still sits today. Cropped, darkened, and faded to black on the left for the page layout.
hero.credit: NASA / David R. Scott (Apollo 15); scan via Project Apollo Archive

footer.title: Mastcam-Z's First 360-Degree Panorama
footer.caption: Perseverance's first 360-degree Mastcam-Z panorama from its landing site in Jezero Crater, Mars (2021), with the rover deck in the foreground. Cropped to a 3.2:1 strip and slightly darkened.
